title: Driving generational growth in the Pilbara
summary: Our plan to invest in Western Australia’s long-term iron ore legacy
body_markdown:
## Related stories


### Western Australia


While iron ore is central to our operations in WA, we have a diverse presence across the state, from salt production in Dampier, lithium at Mt Cattlin, to the legacy of Argyle in the Kimberley and our promising copper-gold project, Winu


### Rio Tinto Into


At Rio Tinto, we’re into many things. From Perth to the Pilbara and beyond, we work with a diverse range of incredible people and partners – whose ideas and love for Western Australia shape our community and business.


### Co-managing Country


A new agreement embeds Indigenous Peoples’ voices at the heart of mining decision-making
